optional chaining.description:
ES2020
obj?.prop, obj?.[expr], obj?.method?.(args)
short-circuits to `undefined` instead of throwing when a reference in the chain is `null`/`undefined`.

nullish coalescing.description:
ES2020
leftExpr ?? rightExpr
returns the right-hand operand only when the left-hand operand is `null` or `undefined` — unlike `||`, it doesn't fall through for other falsy values like `0`, `''`, or `false`.

logical OR assignment.description:
ES2021
x ||= y is shorthand for x || (x = y)
assigns `value` only if the current value is falsy.

logical AND assignment.description:
ES2021
x &&= y is shorthand for x && (x = y)
assigns `value` only if the current value is truthy.

logical nullish assignment.description:
ES2021
x ??= y is shorthand for x ?? (x = y)
assigns `value` only if the current value is `null` or `undefined`.

instanceof.description:
instanceof
The `instanceof` operator tests to see if the `prototype` property of a constructor appears anywhere in the prototype chain of an object. 
the `prototype` actually defines the type, not the constructor function.

JSON.parse() with source access.description:
ES2026 (JSON.parse source text access)
the reviver function's 3rd argument is a context object whose `source` property holds the exact input substring a value was parsed from — lets you recover precision JSON.parse would otherwise lose (e.g. big integers as BigInt instead of a rounded Number).

JSON.rawJSON().description:
ES2026 (JSON.parse source text access)
JSON.rawJSON(text)
wraps a raw JSON text fragment so `JSON.stringify()` emits it verbatim, unparsed — pairs with the reviver's `source` to round-trip values (like large integers) without losing precision.

structuredClone().description:
ES2021 (Web/Node API standardized alongside)
structuredClone(value)
return a deep copy of `value` using the structured clone algorithm — handles Dates, Maps, Sets, TypedArrays, circular references, etc. Throws on functions, DOM nodes, and a few other non-cloneable types.

encodeURI(URI).description:
encodeURI(URI)
encodes a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) by replacing each instance of certain characters by one, two, three, or four escape sequences representing the UTF-8 encoding of the character (will only be four escape sequences for characters composed of two 'surrogate' characters).
new string representing the provided string encoded as a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).

decodeURI(encodedURI).description:
decodeURI(encodedURI)
decodes a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) previously created by encodeURI() or by a similar routine.
return a new string representing the unencoded version of the given encoded Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).
throws an URIError ('malformed URI sequence') exception when encodedURI contains invalid character sequences.

encodeURIComponent(str).description:
encodeURIComponent(str)
encodes a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) component by replacing each instance of certain characters by one, two, three, or four escape sequences representing the UTF-8 encoding of the character (will only be four escape sequences for characters composed of two 'surrogate' characters).
return a new string representing the provided string encoded as a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) component.

decodeURIComponent(encodedURI).description:
decodeURIComponent(encodedURI)
decodes a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) component previously created by encodeURIComponent or by a similar routine.
throws an URIError ('malformed URI sequence') exception when used wrongly.
